hypothesis_results.title: validateHandlerOrder overflow to sqrtPriceX96==0 bypasses max bound
hypothesis_results.description: When SqrtPriceCalculator.computeRatioX96 overflows it returns 0. In validateHandlerOrder, the max bound check 0 > maxSqrtPriceX96 is always false, bypassing the price ceiling. The direct swap afterSwap path at line 847 has an explicit sqrtPriceX96==0 check; validateHandlerOrder does not.
hypothesis_results.economic_impact: Low. View function for CLOB order placement only. Fills gated by beforeSwap/afterSwap.

hypothesis_results.title: Auto-fetch from registry creates empty whitelist DoS for new hook instances
hypothesis_results.description: New AMMStandardHook auto-fetches settings from registry but NOT whitelist contents. Settings with non-zero whitelist IDs block operations until explicit sync.
hypothesis_results.economic_impact: Low. Self-correcting. Admin syncs whitelists to fix.

hypothesis_results.title: validateHandlerOrder missing pair whitelist and trading pause checks
hypothesis_results.description: validateHandlerOrder only checks pricing bounds. CLOB order PLACEMENT bypasses tradingIsPaused and pairedTokenWhitelistId. Order FILLS go through beforeSwap which enforces all checks.
hypothesis_results.economic_impact: Low. Orders placed but not filled while restrictions active.

hypothesis_results.title: Zero price bypasses max bound in pool creation, add liquidity, and pool-type swap
hypothesis_results.description: sqrtPriceX96=0 from pool type causes max check (0 > maxPrice) false. Affects 3 code paths. Only direct swap afterSwap has sqrtPriceX96==0 check (line 847). Bypass only works with ceiling-only bounds (min=0).
hypothesis_results.economic_impact: Low. Requires pool type to return price=0, unrealistic for production.
hypothesis_results.previously_reported: CP-003 covers validateHandlerOrder. 3 additional paths new.

hypothesis_results.title: setTokenSettings syncs raw calldata (initialized=false) instead of corrected memory copy
hypothesis_results.description: Line 397 passes calldata settings (initialized=false) to hooks instead of memSettings (initialized=true). Hook re-fetches from registry on every call.

hypothesis_results.title: Pool disabled toggle enables selective censorship via frontrunning
hypothesis_results.description: Pool disabled state takes effect immediately. Admin-controlled action (FP pattern #4).

hypothesis_results.title: Stale tstore activation copies stale sstore values to transient storage
hypothesis_results.description: Timing window does not exist. AMM reentrancy protection, tstore cleared between txs, runs once.

hypothesis_results.title: SingleProviderPoolType.createPool has no sqrtPrice validation
hypothesis_results.description: createPool line 73 stores sqrtPriceRatioX96 without MIN/MAX validation. DynamicPoolType validates. Swaps still validate independently.
hypothesis_results.economic_impact: Low. Pool creation with invalid price does not directly cause loss.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence bug in setPricingBounds (minSqrtPriceX96 | maxSqrtPriceX96 == 0)
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Solidity | has higher precedence than ==, making the expression correct: (a | b) == 0. Type system proves it: uint160 | bool would not compile.
Reentrancy guard prevents mid-swap activation. tstore cleared between txs. Runs once.

BPS math caps at 10000 BPS (100%). fee = amount * BPS / 10000 <= amount.
